chunks: Ali b. Ahmad b. Abdullah b. Ahmad b. Abi Abdillah al-Barqi narrated to us. He said: My father narrated to me from his grandfather Ahmad b. Abi Abdillah. He said: My father narrated to us from Ali b. al-Nu'man from Fadl b. Yunus from Abdullah b. Sinan. He said: Abu Abdillah al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) said:

Whoever says twenty-five times every day: 'O Allah! Forgive the believing men and the believing women, and the Muslim men and the Muslim women,' Allah will record for him, for every believer who has passed and every believer who remains until the Day of Resurrection, a good deed, and will erase from him a sin, and will elevate him by a degree.

key_terms.اغفر: Forgive — the imperative form asking Allah for pardon
key_terms.المؤمنين والمؤمنات: Believing men and women — those with faith (iman)
key_terms.المسلمين والمسلمات: Muslim men and women — those who submit to God (islam)
key_terms.حسنة: Good deed — a meritorious act recorded by Allah
key_terms.درجة: Degree/rank — a level of spiritual elevation
key_terms.سيئة: Sin — an evil act recorded against the person

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for saying 'O Allah forgive the believing men and women' 25 times daily according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq teaches that repeating the prayer for forgiveness for all believers and Muslims twenty-five times daily earns immense reward. The reward is proportional to the total number of believers throughout history, with each count bringing a good deed, erasing a sin, and raising one's spiritual rank.

en.bilal-muhammad: `Ali b. Ahmad b. `Abdullah b. Ahmad b. Abi `Abdillah al-Barqi narrated to us. He said: My father narrated to me from his grandfather Ahmad b. Abi `Abdillah. He said: My father narrated to me from `Ali b. al-Nu`man from Fadl b. Yunus from `Abdullah b. Sinan. He said: Abu `Abdillah al-Sadiq (as) said:

Whoever says: “O Allah! Forgive the believing men and women, and the Muslim men and women (Allahummaghfir lil mu’minin wal mu’minat wal muslimin wal muslimat)” twenty-five times in a day, Allah will record [a reward] for every believer that has passed and every believer that will remain until the Day of Resurrection, and He will erase a sin from him, and elevate him by a degree.
